name: Clerk
solves: Provides a fully managed authentication and user management platform with pre-built UI components for sign-up, sign-in, and profile management, eliminating the need to build auth infrastructure from scratch.
best_for: Next.js or React apps that need polished, pre-built authentication UI components out of the box
SaaS applications requiring multi-tenancy with organizations, roles, and permissions
Projects that want managed auth with social login, MFA, and user profiles without running any auth infrastructure
Teams that need to ship authentication quickly and are comfortable with a hosted/paid service
B2B applications needing organization-level access control and member management
skip_when: You need a fully self-hosted or open-source authentication solution with no vendor dependency
Your project has a tight budget and cannot afford a paid authentication service beyond the free tier
You need authentication for a non-JavaScript backend (e.g., pure Python, Go, or Rust server)
You require complete control over the authentication database and token issuance logic
You are building a simple API-only service that only needs JWT verification without user-facing UI
